name: Shindrell Swiftfire
summary: Astranaar’s defense reaches beyond Ashenvale’s forest. Shindrell Swiftfire, a night elf sentinel and scout, watches from the town at the heart of night elf operations in Ashenvale. Alert to changing dangers along Kalimdor’s western reaches, she directs capable Alliance adventurers toward threats on the coast and nearby mountain passes, helping coordinate local defense against dangers from sea and wilds.

sections.title: A Watchful Eye in Astranaar
sections.body: From Astranaar’s winding walkways, Shindrell Swiftfire watches the frontiers beyond Ashenvale. Sentinels face Horde logging incursions from the east and south, while Shindrell keeps watch beyond the woodland itself. Travelers arrive from Darkshore or set out toward Stonetalon’s jagged ridges, and she helps ensure Astranaar is not left undefended against danger from the flank.

sections.title: The Menace on the Coast
sections.body: On Ashenvale’s northwestern shore, the troubled Zoram Strand draws Shindrell’s attention. Hostile naga have emerged from the ocean depths, a grave mystery and a direct threat to Kaldorei settlements. Shindrell sends seasoned fighters to investigate the shoreline and coordinate with scouts near the coast, seeking to contain the serpentine invaders before they gain a lasting foothold on ancient night elf lands.

faq.q: Where can I find Shindrell Swiftfire?
faq.answer: Shindrell Swiftfire is stationed in Astranaar, the central night elf town in Ashenvale. Among its wooden walkways, she coordinates scouting and receives travelers.

faq.q: What is Shindrell's role in Astranaar?
faq.answer: In Astranaar, Shindrell coordinates scouts and gives Alliance adventurers directions toward threats beyond the town. These include naga on the western coast and wild beasts in nearby mountain ranges.

faq.q: Why does she send scouts to the Zoram Strand?
faq.answer: Hostile naga have surged onto Ashenvale’s western shores, claiming ruins and threatening night elf borders. Shindrell sends adventurers to scout the beaches and help field sentinels curb the serpentine threat.

faq.q: What connects Shindrell to Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Hidden sources in Theramore report that orc assassins gather venom from pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains for secret raids against the Alliance. Shindrell sends adventurers to collect the venom sacs and deny the Horde that poison.

faq.q: Does Shindrell have ties to Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Shindrell has no direct ties to Blackfathom Deeps. She sends adventurers against the Wrathtail naga on the Zoram Strand, the northwestern coast where the Deeps lies, but sends no one into the Deeps itself.

faq.q: Who is Kayneth Stillwind, and why does Shindrell mention him?
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind is a druid at the shrine of Forest Song in eastern Ashenvale. Fearing corruption is moving through the forest, he asked Shindrell for a report on the coast and Astranaar; she sends adventurers to carry it to him.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Shindrell as one of the vigilant Sentinels guarding Ashenvale’s fringes against ancient foes like the naga, while most of their forces face the Horde.
As an Alliance arrival in Astranaar, you can look to Shindrell as an operational bridge guiding you deeper into central Kalimdor’s contentious and dangerous terrain.
As a hunter, you may recognize the value of tracking pridewings and assessing untamed coastlines, work suited to scouts and rangers who know how to survive in the wild.
